metricNotes.elapsedMs: Warm-up then seven samples; medians/ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals; profiler elapsed omitted
metricNotes.heapGrowthBytes: Observed net heap change, not allocated bytes
metricNotes.retainedHeapBytes: Explicit post-GC observed difference; useful retained Node forks, noisy/zero/negative Bun values are not absence of memory
metricNotes.rssBytes: Observed per-sample process RSS, cumulative inherited process state
metricNotes.allocatedSampleBytes: One separate Node inspector sampling pass, sampling interval4096B; estimate, not exact allocation count or speed
metricNotes.afterOverBefore: Only formed for positive before median; signed heap deltas are not speed ratios
